title: Trowel
body:
"Defend your area with a thing of bricks, while supplies last!"

Description

The Trowel is a special item bought in the Classic Store for $777. It is part of the random rotation in the store.

When used, it creates a wall of painted sand (4 in height and 3 in length). It also makes a sound similar to the sound of the original Trowel in roblox. The wall disappears after about 20-30 seconds.

Trivia

  • A wall appears when used. Initially, it does not have an owner and is displayed as an interactive object.
  • You can move it with your hands.
  • The wall will instantly disappear if you throw out the trowel.
  • The wall is not subjected to any processing.
  • The wall has a random color when created.
